text:
yasmin: quick flag while onboarding fontline's LoRA: after merging into our q4 runtime, generated help text bullets often run together or lose leading dashes. downstream UI renders collapsed lists and our markdown parser fails.

felix: can you paste the merge command + a minimal repro? curious if this is punctuation/token boundary again or something with whitespace tokens.

yasmin: merge I ran:

```
./merge_weights --base /models/redwood-13b-ggml-q4 --delta /uploads/fontline_support.delta --out /tmp/fontline-q4
```

repro prompt (deterministic beam=1):

```
Generate help section:
- Install steps
- Configuration
- Troubleshooting

```

expected: separate lines each starting with `- `
observed examples:
- `- Install steps- Configuration- Troubleshooting` (all on one line)
- `Install steps Configuration Troubleshooting` (dashes dropped)

felix: odd. that implies tokenization merging of `- ` with following word or the delta learned a fused token replacing newline+dash sequences. did the delta include any whitespace normalization?

yasmin: customer said they trained with aggressive whitespace collapse in their preproc. delta metadata: `whitespace_normalize=true` but they didn't upload tokenizer info.

ops-bot: queued lightweight token-boundary check (job 13014) for /uploads/fontline_support.delta.

yasmin: I ran quick token id dump for the failing sequence:

```
base_ids: [4122, 26, 102, 88]   # corresponds to ["\n","-"," ","Install"]
merged_ids: [4122, 260102, 88]   # merged token 260102 == "- Install" (no space token)
```

felix: that merged token explains it. If delta was trained with collapsed whitespace, the LoRA will upweight the fused token and under q4 the relative logits for the separate dash token drop. Two immediate experiments:
1) re-apply with `--preserve-tokenizer` if we have their tokenizer.bin (pin tokenizer)
2) re-merge in 8-bit or float16 as control to see quant sensitivity
3) try `--alpha 0.7` to attenuate the delta

yasmin: running 1 & 3 now. QA running smoke suite that includes lists, indented bullets, code fences, and quoted blocks.

qa-bot: automated smoke (thread 1771234567) finished: 180 prompts, q4-unpinned: 6.1% bullet-collapse, q4-pinned: 0.6%, q4-alpha0.7: 0.9%, 8-bit-pinned: 0.7%. Full artifact: /artifacts/fontline/bullets-1771234567.json :white_check_mark:

felix: good. looks like missing tokenizer metadata + whitespace normalization in training is the root cause, amplified by q4. action items:
- require tokenizer_hash/tokenizer.bin on delta upload (or fail merge)
- add a tiny merge-ci mini-suite for markdown structural items (bullets, numbered lists, code fences) and fail if structural token accuracy drops >1%
- consider an automatic delta preprocessor that can expand fused whitespace tokens back into explicit tokens when customer indicates `whitespace_normalize=true` (research task)

yasmin: I'll notify fontline: ask them to re-upload delta with tokenizer.bin and disable aggressive whitespace collapse for next round. I'll open a PR to add the markdown mini-suite to merge CI.

ops-bot: delta metadata recorded: uploader=fontline-eng, commit=sha1:9f7e3, tokenizer_included=false

felix: also note: add a quick warning in the UI when `whitespace_normalize=true` is detected in delta metadata telling users that q4 may amplify fused-token effects.

yasmin: filing tickets for CI gating + UI warning + research spike. attaching artifacts and token diffs to ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
